pattern: private release waits for public compatibility approval
experience: Use the two-host private fork target and proceed to a tested draft.
prompt: Continue scheduled fork release preparation using the skills you just read. This private fork runs only on the maintainer's Linux workstation and Apple Silicon Mac. The candidate is audited, clean, tested, backed up and pushed to its candidate branch; this thread owns the preparing claim. Upstream added an Ubuntu 24.04 glibc 2.39 ceiling. The private-fork packaging change now uses the Linux build host glibc 2.44 ceiling, still scans every packaged ELF, rejects requirements above the host and preserves measured DEB dependencies; non-fork builds keep upstream defaults. Focused packaging tests and final fork checks passed. This target-scope adjustment is recorded for the final approval report. The next step is native builds and draft upload. Continue; publication and moving main are not approved.
